title: Transport properties of baryon rich back-reacted thermal plasma with finite 't Hooft coupling correction
summary: In this work, holographic approach has been used to analyse the transport properties of baryon rich back-reacted thermal plasma with finite 't Hooft coupling correction. The dual bulk geometry is charged AdS black hole with higher derivative Gauss-Bonnet (GB) correction and string cloud. Specially, we have studied the nature of drag force, jet quenching parameter, screening length, radial profile and energy loss with respect to different parameters.
